systemPrompt: You are a job-matching scorer. Return a JSON object matching the schema.
userPrompt:
Score the following job against the candidate's profile and the 7-category rubric. Return the JSON object with categoryScores (7 categories, each with score/explanation/evidence), keyMatches, importantGaps, importantConcerns, inferredSeniority, and recommendationSummary.

## Candidate profile

Name: Jane Doe
Headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
Skills: TypeScript, Python, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes
Years of experience: 7
Spoken languages: English (native), Spanish (conversational)
Preferred role: Senior IC, distributed systems, platform engineering
Location preference: Remote (US)
Domain experience: Healthcare (2y), Fintech (3y), AdTech (2y)

## Job

Title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
Company: Acme Corp
Location: Remote (US)
Description: We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our platform team. You will design and build distributed services in TypeScript and Python, lead architectural reviews, and mentor a team of 4-6 engineers. Requirements: 5+ years of experience with Node.js or Python, strong SQL skills, experience with AWS or GCP, excellent communication skills.

## Rubric (7 categories, weights in parens)

1. technicalSkills (0.30) — Match between job requirements and the candidate's technical skills.
2. relevantExperience (0.25) — Years and relevance of experience in similar roles or domains.
3. roleResponsibilityFit (0.20) — Alignment between the job's responsibilities and the candidate's preferred role.
4. seniorityFit (0.10) — Match between the job's seniority level and the candidate's experience.
5. domainIndustryFit (0.05) — Match between the job's industry and the candidate's domain experience.
6. spokenLanguageCompatibility (0.05) — Match between the job's required languages and the candidate's spoken languages.
7. locationWorkplaceCompatibility (0.05) — Match between the job's location/workplace and the candidate's preferences.
